prompt:
Original Rajasthani/Indian folk-art cutout animation design. Bold consistent black ink outline, flat earthy fills, minimal gradient shading. Decorative geometric fabric motifs, stylized profile face, prominent expressive eye. Readable silhouette, rig-friendly separated limbs, hidden overlap at joints. No photorealism, no 3D render, no anime anatomy, no soft AI gradient, no text. Do not copy any recognizable existing cartoon character or exact reference frame.
Use the approved Village artisan master as the exact identity and style reference.
Produce only ochre angrakha torso with collar and buttons, no arms or head.
Match the master's palette, outline weight, fabric pattern scale, proportions and lighting.
Extend hidden geometry 20–30 px past the visible joint so rotation does not open a hole.
Do not include other body parts, text, labels, ground shadow, or a character sheet.
Transparent PNG, straight alpha, no checkerboard, no white halo.
